Name: QSnet
Description: Storage heat flux: sum of QSwall, QSroof, QSground and QSibld, excluding QSair (positive into storage)

Name: QSair
Description: Heat storage rate in outdoor air below twice the mean building height (not included in QSnet)

Name: QSibld
Description: Storage heat flux into internal elements in buildling

Name: Twall1
Description: Temperature in wall layer 1 (outermost, next to the outdoor surface)

Name: Twall5
Description: Temperature in wall layer 5 (innermost, next to the indoor surface)

Name: Troof1
Description: Temperature in roof layer 1 (outermost, next to the outdoor surface)

Name: Troof5
Description: Temperature in roof layer 5 (innermost, next to the indoor surface)

Name: Tground1
Description: Temperature in ground layer 1 (uppermost, next to the ground surface)

Name: Tground5
Description: Temperature in ground layer 5 (deepest, next to the lower soil boundary)

Name: Tibld1
Description: Temperature in internal building element layer 1 (surface layer, facing indoor air)

Name: Tibld2
Description: Temperature in internal building element layer 2 (between surface and centre)

Name: Tibld3
Description: Temperature in internal building element layer 3 (centre)

Name: Tibld4
Description: Temperature in internal building element layer 4 (between surface and centre)

Name: Tibld5
Description: Temperature in internal building element layer 5 (surface layer, facing indoor air)
